speaker: abel_garnish
text: The fourth act, masters. Nick on the bed, the traverse drawn, and the cup before we spend the parents. Wednesday is the apparel. Today is one pass.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Under the note, Nick, from the first word of it. If you come in on the note, it goes. Nobody startles him.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can hold it if I come in under the note, sir. If I come in on it, it goes. Once. I am not asking to be shown the end.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once, and then leave the cup. The cloth is cold. Lie on it anyway. We are not buying a second courage before dinner.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Once. Under. I did not go up. That is the report. The doublet stays out of it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: There. That one stayed down. Leave it. If you do it twice you will begin to listen to yourself.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And when the cup is done, the Nurse finds her. I will give you half a lung this morning, Will. I have Egeon's kitchen to roar in after dinner, and I am keeping one stop for Saturday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Half a lung, Thomas. Leave something. If the yard has the whole of her today, Saturday is a second helping.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Then the parents, then the Friar, and the curtains shut, and the hall is Master Kemp's for the length of a crust.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Nine-and-twenty lines in the whole book, Sweet Master Shakespeare, a fan to carry, and half a song I am not let finish. Dick Cowley, stand by the post and look hungry. Thou needst no teaching for the hungry.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I need no acting to look hungry at ten in the morning, Master Kemp. Do I put the fiddle down before you come, or when you bid the tune?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Put it up as the Friar goes, Richard, and stop when he bids you play. The turn is short, and it sits beside a bed the yard has just been quiet for.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The fan against the breast, and one line more is not today. Today is what is set down. Since the Jackdaw, Abel's slate has had nothing of mine to chew.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Speak what is on the roll, Master Kemp, and the slate stays in the pocket. Half the song, not the whole of it, or Saturday goes dark before you are done.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: And because the boy is two paces behind you, still as a girl who has taken the cup, the laugh catches in the throat. That is the butter on the crust. Do not explain it.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Master Shakespeare. Benvolio's roll has a blot where a cue should be. I can say the plain line. I would rather not guess the word under the ink.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Bring it to the lodging after Errors. I will copy the cues clean tonight, the blot lifted, and you shall have it before you need it. Not a new speech. The part you already have, mended.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Tonight, sir? I should like it in my hand before the morning I need it, and not the morning after.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tonight. You covered me in January and in October, and you took August at five shillings without a complaint. A clean roll is the thanks, and it is a roll, not a promise of a share.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Write that where a hired man can hear it twice, Abel. He has said tonight.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: May I get off the bed, Master Garnish? The boards are frost under the wool, and the cup is done.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Up, and the cloak at the brazier. Tomorrow is the whole tragedy in apparel. Today was one pass, and it stayed under.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The fan will be by the door on Saturday, Abel, and not before. I am not spending a calendar this morning. Monday may be the thirty-first in another man's book. It is Tuesday in this house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is Tuesday, and Egeon is at two. Richard, the roll, after. Will, the half-song and no more. Thomas, one stop kept. Nick, you were right to come in under. Go and be warm.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot stays on its peg until the morning. I am not timing apparel today.
